title: Rokhlin’s multiple-mixing problem

result.label: Rokhlin’s multiple-mixing problem
result.statement: Proves that every invertible mixing probability-preserving transformation is mixing of all finite orders, resolving Rokhlin's multiple-mixing problem for a single transformation. Correlations among any finite collection of measurable sets converge to the product of their measures whenever all pairwise time separations diverge.
